aiDescription.summary: The resolution directs the Secretary of State to submit a section 502B(c) report within 30 days, with DRL and Legal Adviser input, on Equatorial Guinea's human rights practices and related U.S. assessments and actions. It must cover alleged abuses (e.g., torture, arbitrary detention, disappearances, extrajudicial killings, trafficking), treatment of non‑citizens the U.S. removed to Equatorial Guinea, pre‑removal assessments, security‑assistance risks, 2025–2026 transfers, and bilateral meetings.

description.text: A resolution requesting information on the Republic of Equatorial Guinea's human rights practices pursuant to section 502B(c) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961.

impact.summary: The resolution orders the Secretary of State to submit a 502B(c) report to the Senate Foreign Relations and House Foreign Affairs Committees on human rights in the Republic of Equatorial Guinea. It seeks details about alleged abuses, treatment of non‑citizens the United States removed there, U.S. security assistance risks, agreements or assurances, persons sent in 2025–2026, and meetings with U.S. officials.

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations. (text: CR S963)
